# Overlapping dotenv files warn with both paths and use the last value.
exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin
cp first-fixture a.env
cp second-fixture b.env
cp custom-fixture c.vars
exec sesam add a.env b.env c.vars
rm a.env b.env c.vars

exec sesam run --env-file a.env --env-file b.env -- env
stdout '^DUP=second-secret$'
stderr 'name=DUP'
stderr 'previous_file=a.env'
stderr 'file=b.env'
! stderr 'first-secret|second-secret'

exec sesam run --env-file b.env --env-file a.env -- env
stdout '^DUP=first-secret$'
stderr 'previous_file=b.env'
stderr 'file=a.env'

# --all follows sorted paths; explicit --env-file flags are processed afterward.
exec sesam run --all -- env
stdout '^DUP=second-secret$'
stderr 'previous_file=a.env'
stderr 'file=b.env'
exec sesam run --all --env-file a.env -- env
stdout '^DUP=first-secret$'
stderr 'previous_file=b.env'
stderr 'file=a.env'

exec sesam run --all --env-pattern '\.vars$' -- env
stdout '^DUP=third-secret$'
stderr 'previous_file=b.env'
stderr 'file=c.vars'
! stderr 'first-secret|second-secret|third-secret'

! exists a.env
! exists b.env
! exists c.vars

-- first-fixture --
DUP=first-secret
-- second-fixture --
DUP=second-secret
-- custom-fixture --
DUP=third-secret
